title: ACT-FIVE - Act Five: The Ward Renewal

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The carriage pulls into a perfect circle of clearing, the only place in the preserve where the trees pull back and let you see the open sky. This is where it ends. The Custodian says the ward was first forged here, and here it must be renewed. She tells you it nearly killed her the first time. Then she smiles, old and unafraid, and asks you to stand with her while she does the most dangerous thing she knows how to do.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Protect the Custodian through the ritual, renew the ward, and finish what the job started.

The Custodian says the ward was first forged here, and here it must be renewed. She tells you it nearly killed her the first time. Then she smiles, old and unafraid, and asks you to stand with her while she does the most dangerous thing she knows how to do.

Gmnotes: Act 5 is not a kill-all combat. It is protection under pressure until the countdown reaches 0. Let prior mercy or trust become visible help: warning, charm, positioning, steadier Custodian, or a better aftermath. If the fight drags, Market Correction can spawn easy skeletons so progress can resume without punishing beginners.
Playertakeaway: You signed on for the hard road; this is the hard road. Stand with her and finish it.
Storytakeaway: This is the resolution of everything: the ward, the city, the Custodian, and the choices that brought the party here.
Mechanictakeaway: Act 5 is a defense encounter on a countdown, then a report-choice epilogue gate.
Livetools: none

If package_status=lost, flag that the finale cannot proceed as written until the table recovers, improvises, or accepts an alternate fragile start. If ward_stability is unset, default to fragile and make the first countdown pressure harsher. Keep Open Vale(TM), Market Correction, and soul-economy as GM-side framing unless the packet gate is earned.

Gmprivate: The ward renewal is a real win with a cost. Full soul-economy truth remains a seed, not a lecture. The report choice is the final values mechanic: file-honest, spin-corporate, refuse, or withhold-the-truth. Withhold-the-truth has the largest future fallout but protects the wrong readers from the deepest truth for now.
